observed_public_claims: Remote MCP wallet for paid APIs; policy is stored outside agent context.
Six-tool surface with one spending tool.
Documents hard per-call, session and daily budgets.
Documents known-service/counterparty controls and unknown-counterparty blocking.
Documents owner approval threshold and immediate revocation.
Current public product states x402 v2 settlement on Flare, not Base.
decision: DO_NOT_FUND_OR_CONNECT_FOR_MAINNET_TESTING. Route402 is architecturally relevant because it combines remote key isolation with pre-signature budgets and counterparty policy, but the currently documented Flare settlement fails James's mandatory Base-only C04 control. Retain on competitor/signer watch for Base support or use only as a design reference.
security_rule: No founder key, seed phrase, payment secret, wallet session or generic signing capability is requested or stored.
next_action: Continue candidate search for a remote/isolated signer that combines route402-style hard daily/per-call/counterparty controls with Base mainnet native USDC and machine-testable C01-C12 behavior.
